title: Orchestrated traffic siphon and restore integrity harness for active-passive DR drills
creator: Asha Patel
description: Create a repeatable, automated drill and validation harness that performs an orchestrated traffic siphon (warm->cold region), exercises routing fallbacks and circuit breaker thresholds, and validates backup/restore integrity of critical stores (tokenstore, model artifacts, KV cache). Goal: prove full transactional integrity and SLO preservation during planned active-passive failovers and confirm load-shedding behaviour under peak simulated load.
acceptance_criteria: Automated drill can siphon 30% then 100% of write traffic to secondary region and revert without data loss
Checksums for S3 model artifacts and tokenstore backups match after restore in passive region
End-to-end latency spike limited to defined SLO window: p95 increase <= 2x baseline and p99 <= 3x baseline during cutover
Circuit breakers trigger and return healthy state per policy (thresholds exercised and recorded)
Load-shedding policy prevents downstream overload; at least two service tiers exercise graceful degradation with clear error codes
Drill runbook artifacts (logs, dashboards, artifacts) stored in Confluence and linked to ticket
runbook: Pre-drill checklist: schedule 48h notice to on-call, CS, and platform customers; reserve maintenance windows in connected services; snapshot DBs and S3 manifests; validate current release hashes

Create golden backup: run tokenstore export, capture S3 object checksums (sha256) for model artifacts and workflows, record KV cache dumps for warm-build; store manifest at s3://redwood-dr-manifests/{{date}}/manifest.json
Stage passive region: ensure infra orchestration (Terraform) applies identical instance types, GPU drivers, and runtime-1.21 image; run smoke tests on minimal load
Warm artifacts: prefetch model shards and preload KV prefixes used by canary prompts to prime caches and minimize cold-start variance
Traffic siphon phase 1 (partial): use weighted routing to shift 30% reads and 10% writes to passive region; monitor for data divergence and error rates for 30 minutes

Validation after phase 1: run checksum compare for writes (sampled keys), compare tokenstore sequence IDs, and run a set of deterministic prompts through both regions to compare outputs; abort if write divergence > 0.01%

Traffic siphon phase 2 (full): escalate to 100% traffic to passive region for 15 minutes while keeping original region in standby; enable circuit breaker aggressiveness to 60% of baseline on primary to validate fallback

Restore validation: concurrently execute a restore from the golden backup into a fresh tokenstore instance in passive region and validate consistency against live dataset using checksum and application-level reconciliation tests
Rollback: revert routing weights to original values using progressive rollup over 10 minutes if any abort criteria met; initiate incident if rollback fails
Post-drill: capture full traces, upload run artifacts to Confluence page, run post-drill diagnostics to reconcile any drift and schedule follow-up tickets
validation_plan: Checksum pipeline: automated job that computes sha256 across S3 prefixes and tokenstore exports and compares to golden manifest (job: infra/ops/backup-verify#run)
Deterministic prompt cohort: 200 sample prompts with deterministic seeds; compare token-by-token outputs and log deltas to drift dashboard
SLO guardrails: synthetic traffic generator reproducing baseline QPS; monitor p50/p95/p99 and error budget burn during each phase

Circuit breaker firing validation: inject controlled error rates to upstream model shards to cause latency spikes; assert breakers open at configured thresholds and requests receive 503 with structured error body
Load-shedding validation: at 2x expected peak, confirm low-priority requests receive pre-defined degraded responses (403/429 with 'load_shed' tag) while high-priority requests retain service
monitoring_playback: Alert hooks: #sre-drills channel, PagerDuty schedule Redwood-Platform-Ops, and automated ticket creation on failure patterns
Trace collection: sample 100% of canary requests during cutover for detailed KV cache and kernel-selection analysis
Audit logs: record admin actions (routing changes, restore commands, infra applies) to audit log S3 with integrity signatures
checklist: Confirm on-call rotations and escalation contacts
Run preflight: disk space, GPU driver versions, image pinning confirmed
Backup manifest committed and checksum validated
Feature flags set for canary and rollback paths
Security: KMS keys available in passive region and HSM access verified
Communications: customer-facing status page prepopulated and update cadence defined
